# QA — Motor Inn Auto Group inner-page rebuild (2026-11-04)

## What was checked
- Real live inner-page wrapper from `/highlander-vs-grand-highlander` (same DealerOn chrome).
- Pages rebuilt from this wrapper, replacing only the content in `#content-main`.
- Served the package locally at `http://127.0.0.1:4173/` so all links and resources resolve consistently.
- Screenshots and results are in this folder.
